title: Good index build on a replica set — replicated build, the default
expected_feedback: No violations. A replicated build is the correct default on a replica set, including at 50M documents: the members build concurrently and only a brief exclusive lock is taken at the start and end. Lag is measured with rs.printSecondaryReplicationInfo(), not rs.printReplicationInfo() -- the latter reports the connected member's oplog window. A ROLLING build is not what this is and is not the default: it removes each member from the set (shut down, restart standalone on a different port, build, restore, wait for catch-up), which costs a voting member for the whole window and takes longer. Reserve it for measured CPU or cache pressure. Note that the procedure previously recorded here -- 'connect directly to the secondary and run createIndex()' -- cannot execute at all: a secondary rejects the write with NotWritablePrimary.
